sheet_used: ryk_na174.jpg (primary, printed Preliminary Delimitation 2023, all 6 seats labelled) + ryk_na172_173.jpg (hand-coloured full-district filing, all 6 seats; label clouds fused)
issues: NA-171 has no dedicated filing but appears fully coloured/labelled on both full-district sheets used; recovered directly (approx:false).

Both sheets share the same base map, drawn ~1.5x horizontally stretched vs true geographic aspect; similarity ICP collapsed, so an affine (symmetric trimmed) ICP + TPS was used. rms 5.8 km (printed) / 6.9 km (hand-coloured photo) reflects base-map generalisation, not fit failure.

Internal lines are the k-NN fusion of both sheets' warped label clouds; per-seat IoU between the two single-sheet solutions was 0.39-0.85 (worst NA-172), so internal boundary positions carry an estimated 2-4 km uncertainty.
NA-172 area share differs between the two sheets themselves (0.130 printed vs 0.080 hand-coloured); fused output 0.084.
Western trans-river enclave (2 canvas island polygons) assigned wholly to NA-174 per explicit NA-174 labels on both sheets; enclave pixels too muddy (river overlay) to segment.

Prelim vs final: seat numbering NA-169..174 and boundaries agree between the preliminary printed sheet and the final hand-coloured filing (final populations annotated on it); no renumbering mapping needed.
